Final answer: Tamil National Liberation Alliance (TNLA)

The Tamil National Liberation Alliance (TNLA) is a Sri Lankan political party representing the Sri Lankan Tamil ethnic minority in the country. It was launched on 22 February 2010 as a breakaway faction of the Tamil National Alliance (TNA). The TNLA aims to develop a national identity based on shared characteristics such as culture, language, and political goals, which aligns with the aim of preserving the nation's culture.

Final answer: Tamil National Liberation Alliance (TNLA)
